RFC 2545 Section 3 re-read. e509c7b0a8 changed only the four ze.conf blocks of test/plugin/rfc2545-joint-subnet.ci: each adds a bgp-level filter { import { final accept; } export { final accept; } } because ff2aac12b0 made an EBGP direction with no policy reject every route (RFC 8212 Section 3), so before it the cases hit their completion deadline with nothing relayed. The diff is additions only: every expect (the 0x20 pair on same-link, the 0x10 global-only field on split-link, entity-off-link and recipient-off-link), every reject of FE800000000000000000000000000009 and of a withdrawal, the TOPOLOGY/WIRE markers and the RFC requirement tags are byte-identical. The discrimination records on this carrier verify. Verdict unchanged. Earlier judgement, still standing: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of faf7c5c380. RFC 2545 Section 3: "In all other cases a BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address field only the global IPv6 address of the next hop (the value of the Length of Network Address of Next Hop field shall be set to 16)." faf7c5c380 (filter chain model moved into internal/component/policy) changed one line in the tagged unit internal/component/bgp/reactor/rfc2545_forward_owned_policy_test.go::TestRFC2545ForwardPolicyOwnGlobalJointSubnet: mustPolicy(t, []filterapi.FilterRef{{Name: "ipv6:own-global"}}, filterapi.FinalAccept) became mustPolicy(t, []routepolicy.Ref{{Name: "ipv6:own-global"}}, routepolicy.FinalAccept). mustPolicy still calls filterapi.NewPolicy with the same single unbound ref and the explicit accept final (NewPolicy now wraps policy.NewChain; an unbound ref stays external as the zero inProcess field did), so the policy the fixture installs, every input and every assertion are unchanged. No other commit touched the file since the verdict was stamped. The unit still requires exactly one IPv6 policy call, exactly two recipient UPDATEs, and through rfc2545AssertNative the complete native field: the own global plus fe80::1 on the common link, the own global alone (16 octets) on recipient-off-link, on both cached and rs rails, auto and unchanged modes, operation and raw policy; the legacy sibling must keep its NLRI and IPv4 next hop. Every other tagged carrier is byte-identical. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Ran: go test -tags ze_bgp -run over the six faf7c5c380-changed reactor units, PASS on 2026-10-31.
